description:
Over 168 km RSTBC Trails and 23.55 km Treaty land Trails from Sarah Point to Saltery Bay, this trail provides for hut to hut hiking or for day hikes from several access points along the way. The varied terrain and forest provides for beautiful vistas and ever changing surroundings. Check with the Tourism Info Centre in Powell River for more details and for current weather information.

SPECIAL NOTE:

Temporary Sunshine Coast Trail closures near Saltery Bay

Temporary closures will be in effect on portions of the Sunshine Coast Trail at Saltery Bay / Jervis Inlet North to support construction activities and ensure public safety.

Lower trail at Ahlstrom Point ? closed October 13, 2026 to February 28, 2027

Upper trail at Saltery Creek - closed October 13, 2026 to April 25, 2027

An alternate route will remain available throughout the closure period. Trail users can use Saltery Bay FSR Br 01 to travel between the Saltery Bay trailhead and Rainy Day Lake, where they can reconnect with the Sunshine Coast Trail and continue north toward Elephant Lake and Lois Lake.

These temporary closures are required to support construction activities associated with the Jervis Inlet and Agamemnon Channel Power Line Replacement Project.

To learn more about this project, please visit bchydro.com/jervisagememnon or contact Nubia Souza Budau at 604-916-8903 or nubia.budau@bchydro.com.
directions: From Saltery Bay Ferry terminal take the logging road to the North (right after unloading from the ferry) at the terminal gates. Follow for 200 meters to the parking lot on the right
